slices.focus: January trainings succeed and Colleen opens spring bookings with three defined packages, marking a clear step toward program stability.
slices.summary: January volunteer trainings go better than expected. Colleen now runs three school packages (basic museum visit, neighborhood fire safety, and a new city services/response package). Laminated station checklists reduce improvisation. Volunteer assignments are tightened to stations and handoffs. A real test run shows the structure holds without one star guide. Colleen feels 'more planted' than triumphant, seeing the program as less fragile than before.
